method: Local ASGI, warmed resident model, fresh SQLite FULL store per paired run. Both modes use the same approved manifest; only the HTTP fast-path flag changes. Alternating run order. Client latency includes server queues/JSON; client concurrency semaphore wait excluded. Nearest-rank percentiles. Source hashes checked before/after. Paired payload equality, probability drift and label flips are recorded. Request latencies and cache-hit flags preserve input order; prewarmed/new slices are separate. Actual Torch input tensor shapes are recorded for every forward attempt. Prewarmed hits must match exactly. No TCP or model-load timing. Small tail sample and uncontrolled machine load limit interpretation. Synthetic timings measure orchestration, not neural inference.
